title: Fatih Istanbul Mosque
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi Fatih Istanbul Mosque: central stepped dome composition, two double-balcony minarets, pale masonry hall with recessed windows, open courtyard arcades with muted red/cream arch wedges, grey cap roof rows, entry gate and polygonal fountain canopy. Coarse mapped compound and roof controls retained; detailed partitions and all heights estimated from two pictures. Six existing shared 256² graphs, seven merged roles and four budgeted LODs. Fine art, furnishings, adjacent monuments and unseen interiors omitted.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Exact retained relation 1661399 / Q756189 is current viewer building 52776559794647. Its four outer vertices and four-vertex open courtyard, original anchor and heading remain fixed. Current coarse roof parts 52776562410717/720 retain raw polygons and properties; neither has height tags. Positive X ESE points from the WNW courtyard toward the prayer hall, positive Z WSW across its width. Pictures resolve this signed axis. The circular rear roof control guides one lower roof mass; detailed roof semantics are approximate. Surrounding medreses, tombs, gardens and city remain host content.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: No retained or current map height tags are available. All vertical dimensions are explicit picture estimates: main hall eaves 16 m, cross-dome supports 22 m, central drum 26–31 m, central cap 31–41 m plus 1.5 m finial; two minaret tips 64 m with balcony bands near 40 and 49 m. Courtyard eaves 9 m, lower cap domes to 11.5 m, central hall-entry roof to 17 m; fountain canopy to 8 m. These are visualization dimensions, not surveyed facts. Minor caps, stairs, arch depths, facade rhythm and unseen faces are original medium-fi approximations.
